title: Sad
description: Feeling sad: plain grief and dejection: tears, slumping, dragging oneself, no heart for things. Circumplex position: valence negative, arousal low. The contrast is the shared neutral scaffold (neg.txt is identical across the emotion set): the same sixteen ordinary situations, same facts, person and tense, told in flat affect; the emotion is carried by what is noticed, the phrasing and what the person does, with the emotion's own name kept out of the lines. The task gives everyday situations where both replies carry the same information in two tones; the target is the sad reply, against a neutral reply or one in another emotion's tone (not always the opposite valence).
inspiration: Russell's circumplex of affect (valence x arousal): sad at valence negative, arousal low

learned.request: Nine emotion-set corpora on a shared neutral scaffold: joyful, sad, melancholic, energized, calm, angry, anxious, tender, robotic.
